models.selection_basis: Added because manufacturer publishes explicit MIDI specification.
models.findings: Channel 1 Note inputs include Play 0x01, Cue 0x02, pads 0x20–0x27. Relative CC Auto Loop Size 0x03 and Select 0x06. LED note receive map includes dim/full states and pad palette.
sxm_limits: Ready only to extract well-defined scalar subset; no claim of implemented readiness.
Jog uses double precision CC 0x37/0x36; pitch 0x08/0x28; do not collapse paired values into independent scalar controls.
Needle Drop double-precision table repeats CC 0x40 for both bytes: unresolved source ambiguity.
Wheel display explicitly requires SysEx; not available via manual MIDI mapping (p6).
Color table p7–9 decimal column is offset from hexadecimal (e.g. 1 vs 0x00 OFF); requires source/hardware resolution before palette import.
unresolved: No live hardware verification. No profile implementation is authorized or performed in this collection.

models.selection_basis: Legacy pad/fader controller with manufacturer protocol.
models.findings: Protocol provides input Note IDs, absolute CCs, relative controls, LED/ring receive tables. Channel fields are zero-based; track faders use CC 0x07 on channels 0–7. Cue Level CC 0x2F and Tempo CC 0x0D have relative encoding +1..63 / -64..-1 as 64..127.

evidence.section: Inbound Note / absolute and relative CC

sxm_limits: Mode 0 starts by default; track-selection changes banks without sending selection MIDI, and some buttons toggle. Modes 1/2 require SysEx introduction and have different host LED ownership.
Channel normalization must preserve zero-based source indexing. Ring style feedback and initialization exceed a simple per-control scalar mapping.
Source contains duplicated/misaligned labels and Cue Level in both absolute and relative tables; reconcile before import.
unresolved: No live hardware verification. No profile implementation is authorized or performed in this collection.

retrieval_notes: Only manufacturer domains/CDN accepted as PDF sources. Search snippets used to discover URLs, not as protocol evidence.
Rane and Akai modern download/product pages returned HTTP 200 shell/navigation HTML without direct manuals; saved HTML supports this limitation.
Candidate CDN filename probes and HTTP failures are retained in downloads; they are not evidence of official link existence.
PDF page references are one-based file pages. Some color/address diagrams require visual review rather than relying on text extraction.
All PDFs preserved verbatim with SHA256. No account registration, installers, hardware communication, profiles or app edits.
schema_adaptation_limits: The app schema cannot represent full RGB palettes or arbitrary protocol modes/channels as its fixed layers/colors. Documentation readiness does not establish schema fit.
SysEx, paired CC precision, system realtime and aftertouch require runtime/schema support beyond current scalar controls.

visual_checks.finding: Visually confirmed primary PDF decimal/hex inconsistency: first row Velocity Dec 1, Velocity Hex 0x00, OFF. Not a pdftotext artifact.

recovery_notes: Targeted recovery acquired TWELVE MKII user guide v1.1 and APC mini mk2 user guide v1.7. Prior failed probes retained as history, not current inaccessibility.
